assertions.title: AppLayout renders with all regions present
test_names: Skip link is first focusable element
navigation landmark is present
assertions.notes: Skip link focus and nav[aria-label=Primary] landmark are tested, but no explicit assertion for role=banner on header, role=main on main, or id=main-content. Tests touch individual regions but no single test verifies the complete app shell structure described by the assertion.

assertions.title: Header displays title and action slots
test_names: displays main heading
displays connection status
assertions.notes: h1 visibility and ConnectionStatus indicator visibility are both verified, but no test exercises the header action slots as a group (ThemeToggle + ConnectionStatus + UserMenu co-located in header actions region).

assertions.title: Main content area is scrollable
assertions.notes: No Playwright test asserts overflow-y: auto/scroll on the main content area. No existing coverage.

assertions.title: Content wrapper contains navRail, sidebar, and main in correct layout
test_names: renders as horizontal bottom bar on mobile
all four buttons visible on mobile
assertions.notes: Responsive nav rail visibility and mobile bottom-bar positioning are tested, but the left-to-right ordering (navRail | sidebar | main) and width ratios on desktop are not asserted.

assertions.title: NavRail renders icon buttons for Kanban, Monitor, Settings
test_names: renders all four navigation buttons
all buttons have aria-labels
assertions.notes: Verifies nav buttons for Kanban, List, Terminal, Settings are rendered with aria-labels. Note: the current app exposes four buttons (Kanban, List, Terminal, Settings) where the contract describes three (Kanban, Monitor, Settings) — Terminal maps behaviorally to Monitor.

assertions.title: NavRail Workspaces button is active when on kanban or table view
test_names: Kanban button is active by default
clicking List switches to table view
active state communicated via data-active
assertions.notes: Active state (data-active="true") verified on Kanban for default view and on List after switching to table view.

assertions.title: NavRail Settings button is active when on settings view
test_names: clicking Settings switches to settings view
assertions.notes: Verifies Settings button gains data-active="true" after click and Kanban loses data-active.

assertions.title: NavRail Monitor button is active when on monitor or terminal view
test_names: clicking Terminal switches to terminal view
assertions.notes: Verifies Terminal button gains data-active="true" after click (Terminal is the app's realization of the Monitor concept from the contract).

assertions.title: NavRail button click triggers navigation
test_names: clicking List switches to table view
clicking Terminal switches to terminal view
clicking Settings switches to settings view
clicking Kanban returns to kanban view
rapid view switching works correctly
assertions.notes: Every nav button click is covered: each click activates the target button and deactivates previously active buttons; view-specific UI (issue-table, terminal wrapper, kanban column) appears after click.

assertions.title: NavRail icons have aria-hidden="true"
test_names: SVG icons are hidden from screen readers
assertions.notes: Iterates every SVG inside the nav rail and asserts aria-hidden="true" (nav-rail.spec.ts:637).

assertions.title: NavRail buttons have visible tooltip on hover
test_names: tooltips appear on hover
tooltips show correct labels
assertions.notes: Tooltip visibility on hover and correct label text verified for all four nav buttons.

assertions.title: NavRail buttons have keyboard focus ring visible on Tab
test_names: buttons are keyboard focusable
assertions.notes: Tab order traversal through Kanban → List → Terminal → Settings verified via toBeFocused() (nav-rail.spec.ts:600). Focus ring visibility itself is CSS-driven; keyboard focusability is asserted.

assertions.title: WorkspaceBreadcrumb displays view label
test_names: shows Kanban label on default view
assertions.notes: h1.getByText("Kanban") verified on default view (workspace-breadcrumb.spec.ts:266).

assertions.title: WorkspaceBreadcrumb shows correct view label
test_names: shows List label on table view
shows Terminal label on terminal view
shows Settings label on settings view
updates to List when clicking List NavRail button
updates to Terminal when clicking Terminal NavRail button
updates to Settings when clicking Settings NavRail button
updates back to Kanban when clicking Kanban NavRail button
assertions.notes: View labels per URL ?view= query param and NavRail-driven updates are verified. Note: the test labels ('Kanban', 'Terminal') differ slightly from the current source labels ('Aether Project', 'Monitor') in WorkspaceBreadcrumb.tsx — possible test/source drift to flag separately, but the behavior (label changes with active view) is exercised.

assertions.title: WorkspaceBreadcrumb shows "Aether" when no workspace
test_names: shows Cortex when workspace has no repos
shows Cortex when workspace API returns error
assertions.notes: Zero-repo and error-fallback paths are exercised, but the tests assert h1.getByText("Cortex") while the source component renders "Aether" (WorkspaceBreadcrumb.tsx:40). The test currently asserts against stale text; concept is tested but the specific evidence text differs from the assertion.

assertions.title: ThemeToggle renders button with sun/moon icon
assertions.notes: No Playwright spec exists for ThemeToggle. No existing coverage.

assertions.title: ThemeToggle button has correct aria-label
assertions.notes: No Playwright assertion on ThemeToggle aria-label ("Switch to dark/light mode"). No existing coverage.

assertions.title: ThemeToggle click calls onToggle callback
assertions.notes: No Playwright test clicks ThemeToggle and asserts the toggle behavior.

assertions.title: Theme persists in localStorage
assertions.notes: No Playwright test asserts localStorage theme value after toggle.

assertions.title: Theme applies data-theme attribute to <html>
assertions.notes: No Playwright test asserts documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme").

assertions.title: Theme sets colorScheme style on <html>
assertions.notes: No Playwright test asserts documentElement.style.colorScheme.

assertions.title: Rapid theme toggle has no visual flicker
assertions.notes: No Playwright test performs rapid theme toggles and checks for flicker/stability.

assertions.title: Theme toggle at 320px viewport works
assertions.notes: No Playwright test exercises ThemeToggle at 320px viewport.

assertions.title: ConnectionStatus renders with status indicator dot
test_names: displays connection status
connection status element exists with data-state attribute
assertions.notes: ConnectionStatus visibility via [data-state] selector (app.spec.ts:164), role="status" presence (server-push.spec.ts:115), and data-state value-set assertion [connected|connecting|reconnecting|disconnected] are all verified.

assertions.title: ConnectionStatus indicator is green when state="connected"
test_names: CLI mutation triggers UI update
health check failure shows daemon unavailable overlay
SSE reconnection after network interruption
assertions.notes: [role="status"][data-state="connected"] selector used across multiple integration tests to assert connected state (daemon-recovery.integration.spec.ts:101,211,239,279,321,367,405).

assertions.title: ConnectionStatus has aria-label with full status text
test_names: connection status element exists with data-state attribute
assertions.notes: getByRole("status", { name: /Connection status/i }) implies the accessible name starts with "Connection status" (server-push.spec.ts:124), but no explicit toHaveAttribute("aria-label", ...) assertion for the full text per state (e.g., "Connection status: Connected").

assertions.title: ConnectionStatus has role="status" and aria-live="polite"
test_names: connection status element exists with data-state attribute
assertions.notes: role="status" is verified via getByRole("status") and [role="status"][data-state=...] selectors, but aria-live="polite" is never explicitly asserted. Screen-reader announcement verification relies solely on the implicit role=status mapping.

assertions.title: AuthGate with AUTH_MODE_OPEN renders children (no login gate)
test_names: app loads without auth gate
no auth-related requests made
SSE connects without token
assertions.notes: Covered by auth-integration.spec.ts mode=open suite: asserts children render, no /api/auth/* requests fire, SSE connects without tokens. auth_config_test.go (Go) exists but server-side unit tests do not count as E2E coverage for the frontend gate.

assertions.title: DaemonUnavailableOverlay appears when daemon unreachable
test_names: health check failure shows daemon unavailable overlay
retry now button triggers immediate reconnection
route blocking only affects browser, not server
assertions.notes: Overlay appearance verified via [aria-labelledby="daemon-overlay-title"] selector and #daemon-overlay-title toContainText("lost") (daemon-recovery.integration.spec.ts:184,189).

assertions.title: DaemonUnavailableOverlay has role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
test_names: health check failure shows daemon unavailable overlay
assertions.notes: Overlay presence is verified via [aria-labelledby="daemon-overlay-title"], but role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" attributes are not explicitly asserted by any Playwright test. The source renders them (DaemonUnavailableOverlay.tsx:55) but no E2E check confirms them at runtime.

assertions.title: Header actions region contains ThemeToggle, ConnectionStatus, UserMenu
test_names: displays connection status
assertions.notes: ConnectionStatus visibility in the header is verified via [data-state] selector, but ThemeToggle and UserMenu presence inside the header actions region is not asserted.

assertions.title: UserMenu only renders when auth mode is OIDC and authenticated
assertions.notes: auth-integration.spec.ts covers mode=open (no UserMenu expected) and mode=oidc (app content renders after auth), but no test asserts UserMenu visibility conditional on mode=oidc + valid session, nor its absence in mode=open.

assertions.title: All nav icons have aria-label
test_names: all buttons have aria-labels
assertions.notes: Each nav rail button asserted via toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "Kanban"/"List"/"Terminal"/"Settings") (nav-rail.spec.ts:327).

assertions.title: All interactive elements are keyboard accessible
test_names: buttons are keyboard focusable
Skip link is first focusable element
CreateIssueModal: Tab cycles within modal fields
Shift+Tab wraps from first to last element in modal
assertions.notes: Tab traversal through nav buttons, skip link first-focusable guarantee, and modal Tab cycling all verified. Covers the core keyboard accessibility contract for shell interactive elements.

assertions.title: Icon-only buttons have aria-label
test_names: all buttons have aria-labels
SVG icons are hidden from screen readers
assertions.notes: Icon-only nav rail buttons have aria-labels verified, and SVGs inside them have aria-hidden="true" so the accessible name comes from aria-label alone.

assertions.title: ARIA live region announces SSE-driven list mutations
test_names: error toast has assertive aria-live for screen readers
non-error toasts have polite aria-live
toast has role=alert
assertions.notes: Toast notification aria-live attributes (assertive for errors, polite for success/warning/info) explicitly asserted via toHaveAttribute("aria-live", ...). This is the mechanism by which SSE-driven mutations are announced in this app.

assertions.title: Live region uses polite (not assertive) for non-critical updates
test_names: non-error toasts have polite aria-live
assertions.notes: toast-success, toast-warning, toast-info all verified as aria-live="polite" (toast-notifications.spec.ts:265-271).

assertions.title: Status is never conveyed by color alone
assertions.notes: No Playwright test asserts that ConnectionStatus / status indicators include a text or icon supplement alongside color (e.g., "Connected" text, check/cross icon).

assertions.title: Form fields have programmatic labels
assertions.notes: No Playwright test asserts <label for=...> association or aria-label on shell/auth form fields (login form, settings form inputs). Existing modal tests (CreateIssueModal) are scoped to issue fields, not shell/auth forms.

assertions.title: Landmark regions present
test_names: navigation landmark is present
Skip link is first focusable element
assertions.notes: nav[aria-label="Primary"] landmark is asserted and other terminal-oriented specs wait on [role="banner"], but no single shell test explicitly asserts banner + main + nav + contentinfo landmarks together. Partial coverage.

assertions.title: Private/Incognito localStorage write failure degrades gracefully
assertions.notes: No Playwright test simulates localStorage.setItem throwing (SecurityError/QuotaExceededError) and verifies the app continues to bootstrap.

assertions.title: Corrupt localStorage JSON does not crash bootstrap
assertions.notes: No Playwright test pre-seeds malformed JSON in localStorage (theme/prefs keys) and asserts the app still renders without a crash.
